name: io.github.mattskilly/idiom
title: Idiom
description: Design acceptance for UI: capture flows, inspect findings, plan repairs and verify fixes.

tools.name: idiom_quick
tools.description: Review a public URL with deterministic checks and bounded safe interaction probes.

tools.name: idiom_check
tools.description: Capture configured flows, check UI and intended designs, and return ranked evidence.

tools.name: idiom_issue
tools.description: Read original finding or group evidence, including available screenshot crops.

tools.name: idiom_fix_plan
tools.description: Capture a full flow and return a repair prompt and exact verification arguments.

tools.name: idiom_verify
tools.description: Recapture twice to verify original findings and report introduced findings.

tools.name: idiom_context
tools.description: Read the project design brief, rules, tokens and accepted work.

tools.name: idiom_flows
tools.description: List validated flows, states, viewports and color schemes.

tools.name: idiom_decide
tools.description: Record an explicit human finding judgment or design-system ruling with a reason.

tools.name: idiom_init
tools.description: Scaffold project configuration and design documents without overwriting changed files.

tools.name: idiom_design_add
tools.description: Attach an intended design reference to an authored flow state.

tools.name: idiom_choose
tools.description: Record the human choice and reason between disagreeing design references.

tools.name: idiom_tickets
tools.description: Emit human-accepted findings as clustered triage proposals.

tools.name: idiom_sweep
tools.description: Capture and check flows with optional model critique and bounded triage proposals.

tools.name: idiom_coverage
tools.description: Read route and captured-state coverage and its limits.

tools.name: idiom_baseline
tools.description: Show or record a deterministic flow baseline without changing Git.
